unify_header.title: SVP Engineering, Agentic AI Platforms
unify_header.role_narrative: Led the platform roadmap, core systems architecture, and commercialization of a production-grade generative AI Solution Accelerator within a consulting firm, serving Fortune 500 financial institutions and converting bespoke client delivery into reusable IP deployed across enterprise lines of business.

companion_unify_bullets_context.text:
- bul_unify_001: Owned architecture for a policy-gated agent execution surface powering governed enterprise AI workflows across L0 route-policy dispatch and runtime proof bundle lineage.
- bul_unify_002: Directed CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization through partner-supported deal cycles and usage-based forecasting.
- bul_unify_003: Instituted evaluation gates and telemetry-driven rollback controls that delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows.
- bul_unify_004: Standardized the AI systems lifecycle so client deployments move lab to production in three weeks, down from six months, through managed workflow orchestration.
- bul_unify_005: Engineered distributed cloud execution infrastructure spanning cloud data/runtime integration patterns across Databricks, vector services, and API gateways.
- bul_unify_006: Converted bespoke delivery into reusable platform IP while the engineering team scaled from 8 to 28 to support platform commercialization.
